shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Startin Stuff (8)': Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place (posted 'BHBM/TYFP'), Death Star II: Throne Room, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points and Imperial Arrest Order, plus '(Other Depends)' – per the strategy Imperial Decree vs EBO or Secret Plans otherwise, both already listed under 'Other Red', so that line is not a separate card. These count toward the 60; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
Section headers ('Little Blue 4', 'Big Blue 4', 'Green 2', 'Quick Red 10', 'Other Red 9') are card-type labels, not cards. Total 60 as published.

Posted 'Emp.Palpy(DS2)' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Vader W/Stick' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Vader's Stick' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Janus' Janus Greejatus; 'Dr.E & Ponda Baba' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba.
Posted 'Dengar W/BC', 'Booby Fett W/BR', '4-LOM W/CR', 'IG-88 W/RG' dested Dengar With Blaster Carbine, Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle, 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, IG-88 With Riot Gun.

Posted 'Executor(The one that's IMMUNE)' dested Executor (Dagobah; immune to attrition < 12). 'DS2DB' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'EndorDB' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark); 'Cloud CityDB' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay).

Posted 'Weapon Lev.' dested the Dark Cloud City interrupt Weapon Levitation; 'Imp. Barrier' Imperial Barrier; 'Somethin Special planned for them' Something Special Planned For Them; Secret Plans is an Effect in 2001 (not a Defensive Shield).
The strategy says the deck lacks Mara Jade (not owned) and would rather run a Lord Vader or two instead of Vader With Lightsaber and Darth Vader; the list is kept as posted.
player_note: The post says the deck took second at Meriden the weekend before 12 March 2001; the title calls this list 'Improved', so it may differ from what was played there.
